Here's why this matters for every team that ships software. The key takeaway is simple. Why this matters is that teams lose time. That matters because nobody checks the result. The key point is that checks are cheap. Ultimately, teams should check their work before they ship it to anyone.

We wrote this paragraph to make the fixture long enough for a rate. It talks about checks and teams and the work they do each week, and it keeps going so the word count is realistic. The teams in this fixture review their releases on Fridays and write notes about what they saw.
